 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice A.V.Sesha Sai

Order:

1. This is an application, filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ( for short 'Cr.P.C'), by the petitioners, seeking quashment of F.I.R. No.362 of 2019 of Bhimavaram I Town police station, West Godavari District, registered for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 328 r/w 511, 188 and 273 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 54 r/w 59 of the Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition & registration on sale) Regulations 2011 and the Food and Safety and Standards Act,2006.
2.

opennyai_summary.facts:
1. This is an application, filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ( for short 'Cr.P.C'), by the petitioners, seeking quashment of F.I.R. No.362 of 2019 of Bhimavaram I Town police station, West Godavari District, registered for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 328 r/w 511, 188 and 273 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 54 r/w 59 of the Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition & registration on sale) Regulations 2011 and the Food and Safety and Standards Act,2006.

opennyai_summary.decision:
It is brought to the notice of this Court by the learned counsel for petitioners so also the learned Additional Public Prosecutor that the issue in the present Criminal Petition is squarely covered by the earlier Order of this Court, dated 27.08.2018 in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018.
3. Having regard to the said Order and for the reasons recorded therein, this Criminal petition is also allowed in terms thereof, quashing the proceedings in F.I.R.No.362 of 2019 of Bhimavaram I Town Police Station, West Godavari District.
4.
Office to enclose a copy of the Order, dated 27.08.2018 in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any in the Criminal Petition, shall stand closed.
